description: Land Acquisition - Galloluwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District and An Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1956/03 of 29.02.2016 D/S Division, Naula
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purposes, including location details, boundaries, and survey information. It also includes a rectification notice correcting land area measurements. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes or structural reorganizations, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
